newsitem.title: USA: Prime Retail plans Missouri retail center.
newsitem.headline: Prime Retail plans Missouri retail center.

text.p: Prime Retail Inc said Wednesday that it has signed a memo of understanding with privately-held Sansone Group to develop a 700,000 square-foot $70 million retail and entertainment center in Eureka, Missouri, a suburb of St. Louis.

The mall, to be built on 113 acres, is expected to open in early 1999 and include outlet stores, "big box" value retailers, a large multi-screen theater and restaurants. It is expected to create up to 500 construction jobs and 1,000 to 1,500 permanent jobs once it opens, said Prime Retail.

The company said that as general partner and majority owner, it will arrange construction financing and provide the required equity capital. After receiving a preferred return on its equity investment, profits will be split, 75 percent to Prime Retail and 25 percent to Sansone.
The project, said the company, is also subject to the approval of a tax increment financing district to fund certain required on-site and off-site infrastructure improvements.

Prime Retail is a real estate investment trust, engaged in the development and management of factory outlet centers. Sansone Group is a developer of shopping centers, office buildings and industrial parks in the Midwest.
